subject: ACME - Pricing & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME - Pricing & invoice estimate

Hi Olivia - great to meet you and the team on the call this morning. Quick recap and the attached artifacts (pricing spreadsheet + token model + draft invoice) so your procurement and finance teams have what they need.

Recap / what we discussed:
- Workload profile: short-form assistant + summarization, average prompt+completion ~ 300 tokens, spiky peak windows for end-of-day batch ops.
- Expected monthly volume (customer estimate): 10M - 50M input+output tokens depending on pilot scale.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned target $/1M tokens in the range of $700-$1,200.
- Recommended model: Redwood-codex-v1 (quantized); tradeoff: lower per-token cost at modest latency increase vs candela-large for lower latency/higher cost.

Attached: ACME_pricing_breakdown_v2.xlsx (detailed per-model cost sheet), token_usage_model.csv (your sample ramp scenarios), redwood-invoice-estimate.pdf (one-page invoice for procurement).

Quick summary numbers (baseline estimate):
- Per 1M tokens (Redwood-codex-v1): $950 / 1M tokens (includes 24/7 infra, prefix cache savings, and 5% discount for 12-month commit).
- Monthly examples: 10M tokens => $9,500; 50M tokens => $47,500.

Next steps / asks from ACME:
1) Confirm which monthly volume scenario we should price (10M / 25M / 50M).
2) Do you need a vendor invoice (PDF) + PO number to proceed? If so, please provide billing contact and legal or SOW redlines.
3) If helpful, we can set up a short follow-up with Engineering/FinOps to validate token estimates next week.

Happy to tweak the model assumptions if the token-per-interaction or retention windows differ from what we discussed. I'm available for a 30m follow-up: https://calendly.com/sean-gallagher/30min

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_pricing_breakdown_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), token_usage_model.csv (csv), redwood-invoice-estimate.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Sean - helpful summary and thanks for sending the attachments. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side before we share with procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the per-1M breakdown once more including any volume discounts? The spreadsheet shows a few scenarios and I want a single line item our finance team will use.
2) For the 50M scenario, is there an additional bandwidth/ingress surcharge or is this included in the unit price?
3) Do you charge VAT or should we expect net amounts on the invoice?

We're leaning toward a 25M pilot. Procurement will ask for a PDF invoice and the PoC SOW. If you can provide a one-page invoice with our billing contact (Sales Ops) and a draft SOW, that will speed approvals.

Also please include a simple per-1M tokens table we can paste into our internal budget deck (just the clean number and the scenario label).

Olivia

Hi Olivia - quick answers inline and a clean per-1M table below for your deck. I also attached a one-page invoice (redwood-invoice-estimate.pdf) with Acme billing placeholders - happy to update with PO # and billing address.

1) Volume discounts: base list for Redwood-codex-v1 is $1,100 / 1M. We apply the following stepped discounts (already reflected in ACME_pricing_breakdown_v2.xlsx):
   - 0-10M: list less 10% => $990 / 1M
   - 10-30M: list less 15% => $935 / 1M
   - 30M+: list less 20% => $880 / 1M
   Your 25M pilot would fall in the 10-30M band => $935 / 1M. With the 12-month commit option we discussed that nets to $890 / 1M (final number depends on exact commit and billing cadence).

2) No separate bandwidth/ingress surcharge - included in the unit price.

3) Invoices are issued net of tax; VAT will be applied by Redwood where required based on billing country. We can flag this clearly on the invoice for procurement.

Clean per-1M table for your deck: (Redwood-codex-v1 - committed)
- 1M tokens => $890
- 10M tokens => $8,900
- 25M tokens => $22,250
- 50M tokens => $44,500

If that works I'll send a finalized PDF invoice with billing contact and draft SOW today. Should we use Sales Ops (salesops@acme.com) as the billing contact?

Best,
Sean
